'''Big Time Hero of Beyond-Squib Eliteness''' was an honor bestowed by the [[Squib/Legends|Squibs]]. In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], [[King/Legends|King]] [[Ebareebaveebeedee]] declared [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] an honorary Big Time Hero of Beyond-Squib Eliteness for his role in the [[Battle of Skor II]].
